task.description: WF-03 Step 2b (hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER) for ISS-0705, on branch feature/WF03-ISS0705-20260917 (`git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0705-20260917`; do not re-run git setup). Also verify: the design covers all 3 test files with exact before/after shapes citing real existing helpers (no invented helper), the orphaned-row cleanup command in the design is precise enough to run mechanically and does not risk deleting rows still in use by a running test, and the design contains no implementation code (spec only). result.summary: Independently verified test/support/sandbox_auto_mode.ex source directly (not trusting the design doc or ISSUE-FIXER). Quoted bodies: `def enter_auto_mode!(repo) do Sandbox.mode(repo, :auto) end` (line 86-88) sets :auto. `def exit_auto_mode!(repo) do Sandbox.mode(repo, :manual) end` (line 108-110) sets :manual -- confirmed by its own moduledoc ('Restores :manual mode on repo') and its docstring's LIFO/on_exit ordering guidance. CODE-DESIGNER's §0.1 correction is CORRECT: the task handoff's literal instruction to use exit_auto_mode!/1 at identity_test.exs:1381 and role_registry_test.exs:119 would have set the pool to :manual inside those on_exit/1 callbacks, but both call sites exist specifically to force the pool back to :auto before TenantFixture.provisioned_tenant!/1's own later-running (LIFO) on_exit/1 cleanup (DROP SCHEMA / delete_all) runs -- that cleanup needs a real checked-in connection, which only :auto mode provides from ExUnit's separate OnExitHandler process. Using exit_auto_mode!/1 there would have reproduced the exact leak/hazard class ISS-0705 exists to close. enter_auto_mode!/1 (:auto, no checkout, no process affinity) is the correct helper for both sites. Cross-checked design doc's cited line numbers/shapes against actual source: tenants_test.exs lines 386-432 match exactly (comment block, Sandbox.mode(:auto) at 391, on_exit at 407-418, information_schema query, assert rows != [] at 431); identity_test.exs lines 1355-1386 match exactly (setup block, :manual+checkout at 1374-1375, on_exit at 1381 with the flagged line); role_registry_test.exs lines 101-128 match exactly (setup-start :auto at line 102 -- correctly left untouched per OQ-2 -- and on_exit's forced :auto at line 119). Design covers all 3 required files (§1-§3) plus the orphaned-row cleanup (§5, exact mix run -e command, 129-row precondition/verification, explicitly scoped as an operational one-off script not committed to the codebase -- consistent with the handoff's own framing of it as 'not application code'). No implementation code: all three test-file changes are given as before/after shape with elided unchanged bodies (<dispatch + assertions> etc.), not full compiling modules; §5's fenced command is an explicitly-labeled one-off maintenance script, not a codebase file. Design is unambiguous enough to build from directly -- each of the 3 call sites names the exact line, the exact existing helper, and the exact replacement text with no invented helpers (INV-4 confirms only provision!/2 and enter_auto_mode!/1 are used, both pre-existing).
